name: A/R Aging
summary: How much cash is stuck in receivables, and how old it is.
description: A/R Aging reads customer balances from ${workspace}/finance/ar*.xlsx, totals the cash stuck, buckets the balances into 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ day bands, and lists the oldest balances. Missing workbooks show the setting the card needs, never a zero.
highlights: Total cash stuck plus 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ day buckets.
Oldest balances list with customer, amount, and days outstanding.
Reads only ${workspace}/finance/ar*.xlsx; no plugin code, no network.
